rca of the issue: Bug A (room reassignment leak) RCA: previously POST /rooms/{id}/assign only set room.tenant_id=new but never cleared the previous occupant tenant's room_id/property_id pointers — producing 'orphan' tenants still pointing at a room they no longer occupy. Fix adds two guards at rooms.py:114-119: (1) free requesting tenant's OLD room (status->available, tenant_id=''); (2) free TARGET room's prior occupant (tenant.room_id='', property_id=''). Verified via test_reassign_room_frees_previous_occupant: after reassigning room from t1 to t2, t1.room_id becomes '' and t2.room_id = room_id.
